about.heading: A Knight's history in the Croydon North community
about.text: Croydon North Cricket Club is one of the most successful clubs in the history of the RDCA, fielding junior and senior teams from Under 10s through to our 1st XI. We're a small but proud community club that welcomes new players, families and supporters every season.

cards.title: Hughes Park & Barngeong Reserve
cards.text: Training and home matches are played across our two Croydon North home grounds.

cards.title: Junior Cricket
cards.text: Under 10s through Under 18s — a clear pathway from Milo In2Cricket into senior ranks.

cards.title: Senior Cricket
cards.text: Multiple XIs across RDCA grades, led by our 1st XI in the association's top division.
